title: Sharp Landau-Type Theorems and Schlicht Disc Radii for certain Subclasses of Harmonic Mappings
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the class of all complex-valued harmonic mappings $f=h+\overline{g}$ defined on the unit disc $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ with the normalization $h(0)=0=h'(0)-1$, here $h$ and $g$ are analytic functions in $\mathbb{D}$. In this paper, we investigates Landau-type theorems for several significant subclasses of sense-preserving harmonic mappings.
